mobile.setup.title_repoint.role: Phone setup title, progress, consent or recovery
mobile.setup.title_repoint.note: Account identity already masked; IDs/prices/commands stay verbatim. Subscription activation only at exact fresh monthly quote. No automatic credit purchase; completed billing/reservation is not rolled back. Provider sign-in/terms remain human. Status is read-only. This title names a BLOCKED state whose repair is local: the tunnel pins a sign-in row that is dead or gone while a provable newer row for the same account is on this device.

mobile.setup.repoint.note: No OAuth, purchase or service mutation implied by observation. Commands/IDs/URL stay verbatim; quote is fresh USD monthly activation price. The action re-points an EXISTING tunnel at an EXISTING local sign-in for the same account: no new sign-in, no new subscription, no account change, and no change to the phone address (only the pinned credential row id moves).

mobile.setup.repointed.note: A completed local re-point, not a new sign-in or activation. {id} is the credential ROW id the tunnel now pins (a local store row id, never an account id, email or phone address); it stays verbatim.

mobile.setup.disabled.note: No OAuth, purchase or service mutation implied by observation. Commands/IDs/URL stay verbatim. The tunnel's owner switched it off in the Radient web console; the only fix is the console, and setup deliberately does not re-enable it.

mobile.setup.billing_lapsed.note: No OAuth, purchase or service mutation implied by observation. Commands/IDs/URL stay verbatim. Billing was activated before but the prepaid balance no longer covers it. The fix is adding credit, not accepting a price again.

mobile.setup.reconnect.note: No OAuth, purchase or service mutation implied by observation. Commands/IDs/URL stay verbatim. Shown beside a Reconnect action for a suspended tunnel whose billing is fine; running it charges nothing.

mobile.setup.network.role: Mobile setup progress or blocker (no action button)
mobile.setup.network.note: No OAuth, purchase or service mutation implied by observation. Commands/IDs/URL stay verbatim. Radient could not be reached or timed out; recovery is automatic, so the sentence must not ask the reader to do anything.

mobile.setup.radient_unavailable.role: Mobile setup progress or blocker (no action button)
mobile.setup.radient_unavailable.note: No OAuth, purchase or service mutation implied by observation. Commands/IDs/URL stay verbatim. Radient answered HTTP 5xx; recovery is automatic, so the sentence must not ask the reader to do anything.

mobile.setup.reconnecting.note: Shown while the automatic no-spend reconnect that runs after a Radient sign-in holds the setup lock. It must say nothing is charged and that no action is needed.

mobile.setup.login_offer.role: One-line TUI note after a successful Radient sign-in on a machine without phone access
mobile.setup.login_offer.note: Shown once per sign-in. /mobile enable is a slash command and stays verbatim. The money clause must survive: nothing is charged without the user first seeing the price.

mobile.setup.title_reconnect.role: Phone setup title, progress, consent or recovery
mobile.setup.title_reconnect.note: A suspended tunnel whose billing is fine; the next line names the reconnect command, which charges nothing.

mobile.setup.title_billing_lapsed.role: Phone setup title, progress, consent or recovery
mobile.setup.title_billing_lapsed.note: Billing was activated before, but the prepaid balance ran out. The fix is adding credit in the Radient console.

mobile.setup.title_disabled.role: Phone setup title, progress, consent or recovery
mobile.setup.title_disabled.note: The owner switched it off in the Radient web console; setup will not override that.

mobile.setup.title_network.role: Phone setup title, progress, consent or recovery
mobile.setup.title_network.note: Radient could not be reached; recovery is automatic and nothing needs to be done.

mobile.setup.title_radient_unavailable.note: Radient answered with a temporary server error; recovery is automatic.

mobile.setup.title_reconnecting.role: Phone setup title, progress, consent or recovery
mobile.setup.title_reconnecting.note: The automatic no-spend reconnect after a Radient sign-in is running; nothing needs to be done.

mobile.setup.action_add_credit.note: The one action line under a lapsed-billing title. {url} is the Radient console URL and stays verbatim; no command is named.

mobile.setup.action_open_console.note: The one action line when the owner switched phone access off in the console. {url} is the Radient console URL and stays verbatim; no command is named.

mobile.setup.stopped_plain.note: Plain-language remedy for the desktop setup card and the TUI's /mobile status card, which non-technical users read without a terminal. It must never name a shell command, flag or code span (the button or the TUI's action line carries the action); setup never spends money on its own. The person turned phone access off themselves; the card's button turns it back on. Not an error, not a nag.

mobile.setup.owner_missing_plain.note: Plain-language remedy for the desktop setup card and the TUI's /mobile status card, which non-technical users read without a terminal. It must never name a shell command, flag or code span (the button or the TUI's action line carries the action); setup never spends money on its own. The account that owns the tunnel is no longer signed in here; the card offers that sign-in.

mobile.setup.login_plain.note: Plain-language remedy for the desktop setup card and the TUI's /mobile status card, which non-technical users read without a terminal. It must never name a shell command, flag or code span (the button or the TUI's action line carries the action); setup never spends money on its own. Shown beside the sign-in button.

mobile.setup.choose_account_plain.note: Plain-language remedy for the desktop setup card and the TUI's /mobile status card, which non-technical users read without a terminal. Radient's account/route check did not complete; nothing on this computer changed.

mobile.setup.apply_plain.note: Plain-language remedy for the desktop setup card and the TUI's /mobile status card, which non-technical users read without a terminal. mobile.setup.verification_plain.note: Plain-language remedy for the desktop setup card and the TUI's /mobile status card, which non-technical users read without a terminal. It must never name a shell command, flag or code span (the button or the TUI's action line carries the action); setup never spends money on its own. mobile.setup.failed_plain.note: Plain-language remedy for the desktop setup card and the TUI's /mobile status card, which non-technical users read without a terminal. Setup stopped part-way; completed steps are not undone, so retrying is safe.
